org: Assemblies of God in Guyana · National Youth Ministries Department
kicker: WORLD AOG YOUTH MISSIONS PROJECT · GUYANA
hero_text: Young people giving, going and serving so the Gospel can move farther. In 2026, we are rallying AOG youth across Guyana around a practical missions goal: helping complete roofs for three missionary churches.
about_text: Speed the Light is an Assemblies of God youth missions initiative that disciples young people in generosity, prayer and mission. It helps meet practical missionary needs so the Gospel can travel farther and be communicated more effectively.
project_title: Three missionary churches. One united goal.
project_text: Our 2026 target is to raise funds to help complete roofs and other essential building needs for three missionary churches.
event_text: Churches can shape Speed the Light Day in a way that fits their local ministry: a youth-led service, missions emphasis, fundraiser, outreach or hands-on service project.
director_bio: National Youth Ministries Director of the Assemblies of God in Guyana. This section can be expanded later with the official NYM biography and a project message.
giving_text: You may also give through your local YM President or Youth Pastor, or drop off funds at the Assemblies of God Head Office, Lance & Gibbs Street, Queenstown, Georgetown, Guyana.
